kind: curated LO measurement metadata; complete original raw run retained separately

settings.stopping_criterion: error <= max(relative_error * abs(reference if present else estimate), absolute_floor), minimum training samples, zero final discarded or unstable samples; reference residual never controls stopping
settings.checkpoint_policy: Completed-iteration native snapshots only; no metadata edits or on-disk state reloads

reference.method: independent analytic LO Fermi phase-space moments; no NLO masters

cost.note: Worker allocation cost includes reserved-session overhead; not measured OS CPU time. Build and later rendering are outside campaign duration.
